papers.title_en: How Reliable Is Individualized Functional-Network Attribution in Resting-State fMRI Cognitive Prediction in ADNI?
papers.authors: Sheethal Bhat, Mahfuzur Rahman Chowdhury, Imam Ahmed Shaik, Rose Dawn Bharath, Siming Bayer, Andreas Maier
papers.evidence: ADNI静息态fMRI功能连接归因可靠性评估
papers.tldr: 个体化功能网络归因常被当作可解释的rs-fMRI生物标志物，但其重测信度很少被量化。本文对ADNI中冻结的FC预测器（Schaefer-200预测MMSE/ADAS-Cog13）做逐被试网络消融归因，并引入被试级置换零模型。结果显示分半信度近天花板，但扫描重测信度明显下降，匹配被试对仍显著超过不匹配零模型。作者建议同时报告扫描重测信度与置换零模型对照，以免高估个体特异性。
papers.abstract_en: Individualized attribution estimates which functional networks drive a model prediction for a given subject and is often proposed as an interpretable resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) biomarker, but its test-retest reliability is rarely quantified. We evaluate per-subject network-ablation attribution for a frozen resting-state functional connectivity (FC) predictor (Schaefer-200 FC predicting MMSE/ADAS-Cog13) trained on N=875 subjects from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI), using, and (iii) a subject-level permutation null. Split-half reliability is near-ceiling (Spearman p=0.948/0.950) but drops on scan-rescan (p=0.609/0.616). Under the mismatched-subject null, correlations remain substantial (p~0.46-0.47), indicating strong population-shared structure, yet matched pairs exceed this null (z~6.6-6.9, p<=10-4). Thus, in ADNI, individualized network attribution contains a modest but non-zero person-specific component atop a strong population-shared pattern. We recommend reporting scan-rescan reliability together with a permutation-null control, rather than within-session proxies alone, to avoid overstating individual specificity.

papers.title_en: Every route counts, but some count more: a max-plus view of the C. elegans brain
papers.authors: Emma Reyner-Fuentes, Sebastian Rudolph, Carmen Peláez-Moreno, Francisco J. Valverde-Albacete
papers.evidence: 非欧氏max-plus路由的连接组分析
papers.tldr: 传统连接组分析把所有路径求和，并把神经状态放入欧氏空间，模糊了可能维持内部状态的反馈回路。作者把神经信号视为路由而非扩散，用max-plus代数（信号沿路径累积、最强路径胜出）建模秀丽隐杆线虫的功能连接组。五个网络各自坍缩为少数主导反馈回路，既复现已知回路，也指出新的候选回路。这种基于顺序的描述提示脑状态可能生活在格而非欧氏空间中。
papers.abstract_en: Brains do not simply add up every signal they receive: they select which routes dominate. Yet connectomes are usually analyzed with tools that sum over all paths and place neural states in Euclidean spaces, blurring the feedback circuits that may sustain internal states. Here we treat neural signaling as routing instead of diffusion and describe it with max-plus algebra, in which signals accumulate along a path and the strongest route prevails. We propose a model in which the functional connectome of Caenorhabditis elegans emerges from the time-varying combination of electrical, synaptic, monoaminergic, neuropeptidergic and hormonal layers, and analyze five networks within this framework. Each collapses onto a handful of dominant feedback loops, which recover well-characterized circuits and point to new candidates for experimental study. Unlike linear spectra, these structures keep the biological meaning of the data, and their order-based description suggests that brain states live in lattices rather than Euclidean spaces.

papers.title_en: DRAFT: Decoding and Reconstructing 3D Room Layouts from fMRI and Camera Trajectories
papers.authors: Chi-Wei Lee, An-Kai Chen, Cheng-Han Chiang, Yi-Chun Chang, Po-Chih Kuo
papers.evidence: 利用fMRI信号与相机轨迹解码三维场景布局
papers.tldr: 论文提出仅凭已知相机轨迹与观看室内漫游时的fMRI信号，重建未见过场景的三维房间布局，无需视觉帧。DRAFT从早期视觉皮层提取紧凑布局表征，并与相机运动导出的几何自由空间融合。在10个留出场景、20名参与者上，布局r达0.480，高于仅相机路径的0.446和七种fMRI解码器最高0.429。作为即插即用模块，它无需重训即可把七种解码器的布局r从0.171–0.429提升至0.487–0.493。
papers.abstract_en: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.

papers.title_en: Interpretable Brain Age Prediction Using White Matter Fiber Orientation Distributions with Rotation-Equivariant Deep Learning
papers.authors: Chenyang Fan, Robert D. Sanders, Elie Matar, Yixuan Yuan, Xiang Li, Sharon L. Naismith, Fernando Calamante, Jinglei Lv
papers.evidence: 基于扩散MRI的神经影像人工智能脑龄预测
papers.tldr: 扩散MRI可刻画白质微结构并用于脑龄预测，但DTI标量常丢失方向信息，常规CNN也未显式尊重方向特征的几何变换。本文结合白质纤维方向分布（WM-FOD）与SE(3)等变CNN，直接在球谐系数上学习并保持旋转变换性质。在HCP-Aging 692名36-90岁参与者中，五折模型平均预测的MAE为3.54岁、r=0.958，优于DTI模型和常规CNN。纤维束遮挡分析还揭示了与年龄相关的敏感通路，为可解释脑龄预测提供了新框架。
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion MRI (dMRI) provides information about white matter microstructure that can support brain age prediction. However, many existing prediction models use diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) scalar metrics that omit orientation information. Deep learning is increasingly used for brain age prediction, but conventional CNNs do not explicitly respect the geometric structure of orientation-dependent features. We present an interpretable brain age prediction framework that combines white matter fiber orientation distributions (WM-FODs) with an SE(3) (Special Euclidean group in 3 dimensions) equivariant CNN. The network operates directly on spherical harmonic (SH) coefficients of the FOD, preserving their transformation properties under rotation. Evaluation in 692 participants aged 36-90 years from the Human Connectome Project Aging dataset showed that the combined framework outperformed the evaluated DTI-based models and conventional CNNs. Averaging predictions from five cross-validation models yielded a mean absolute error of 3.54 years and Pearson's correlation of 0.958. Our results indicated that the performance advantage depended on combining WM-FODs with equivariant processing. Prediction accuracy was highest at a maximum SH order of Lmax = 2 and declined at higher orders. Tract-level occlusion, where each segmented tract was masked in turn, revealed age-dependent patterns of model sensitivity, with importance peaks in frontal projection pathways at 36-44 years, the fornix at 45-54 years, the callosal isthmus at 55-64 years, the middle cerebellar peduncle at 65-74 years, and the callosal genu at 75-90 years. These findings support rotation-equivariant processing of WM-FODs for accurate brain age prediction with anatomically interpretable model sensitivity.

papers.title_en: Toward Clinical Translation of Deep Learning-Based Intracranial Super-Resolution 4D Flow MRI Using Multi-Cohort Transfer Learning
papers.authors: Oliver Welin Odeback, Susanne Schnell, Patrick Winter, Johan Lundberg, Fredrik Piehl, Tobias Granberg, Alexander Fyrdahl, David Marlevi
papers.evidence: 深度学习颅内4D血流MRI超分辨及其临床转化
papers.tldr: 颅内4D Flow MRI分辨率受限，深度学习超分辨缺乏跨队列泛化验证。研究先用合成脑血管数据预训练CNN，再以健康、烟雾病和多发性硬化受试者的在体数据做队列特异或混合迁移学习。混合迁移学习平均vNRMSE最低（0.119），优于队列特异模型和仅合成预训练，且超分辨相位对比血管成像的PR-AUC在各队列均高于原生标准分辨率。结果表明多队列迁移学习可提升跨队列重建一致性，超分辨改善血管显示，支持进一步多中心验证。
papers.abstract_en: We evaluated synthetic pretraining and multi-cohort transfer learning for deep learning-based super-resolution of intracranial 4D Flow MRI across heterogeneous neurologic cohorts. This mixed prospective-retrospective study analyzed 18 participants (12 healthy participants, 3 with moyamoya disease, and 3 with multiple sclerosis) with paired 1.2-mm and 0.6-mm 4D Flow MRI scans. A convolutional neural network pretrained on synthetic cerebrovascular data was fine-tuned using cohort-specific or pooled multi-cohort in vivo data. High-resolution-derived inputs enabled voxel-wise evaluation; native standard-resolution scans were used for angiographic and hemodynamic analyses. Synthetic pretraining reduced mean artery-wise velocity-normalized root mean square error (vNRMSE) versus interpolation (0.147 vs 0.166). Pooled transfer learning yielded the lowest mean vNRMSE (0.119 vs 0.127 for cohort-specific models and 0.147 for synthetic pretraining), with narrower 95% limits-of-agreement widths than synthetic pretraining across all test cases (0.109-0.222 vs 0.154-0.278 m/s). Super-resolved phase-contrast angiography achieved higher precision-recall area under the curve than native standard-resolution imaging in all cohorts (0.848-0.896 vs 0.486-0.805). These results indicate that pooled transfer learning improves cross-cohort reconstruction agreement and that super-resolution can improve vessel depiction, supporting further multi-center validation for cerebrovascular imaging.

papers.title_en: FORESEE-MS: Toward Prospective Spatial Forecasting of Future Multiple Sclerosis Lesions from Baseline FLAIR MRI
papers.authors: Maryam Akhavan Aghdam, Sudip Mittal, Noorbakhsh Amiri Golilarz, Shahram Rahimi
papers.evidence: 基于基线FLAIR MRI的深度学习未来多发性硬化病灶预测
papers.tldr: 多发性硬化影像分析多聚焦回顾性病灶检测，基线FLAIR能否前瞻预测未来病灶仍待验证。作者提出FORESEE-MS协议，以折特异人群先验图谱为基线，在MSSEG-2的39例受试者上五折交叉验证五种深度学习模型，并用AUROC/AUPRC及患者内Recall@Top-K%评价。图谱的汇总体素级AUROC/AUPRC最高，深度学习未可靠超越；3D U-Net与Attn+ResBlock+VAE的患者内Recall@Top-K%均值更高，但多数配对置信区间含零。研究提示基线FLAIR可能含患者特异信息，小样本下其相对人群先验图谱的增益仍不确定。
papers.abstract_en: Traditional multiple sclerosis (MS) image analysis has primarily focused on retrospectively detecting and segmenting lesions. This study investigates whether baseline FLAIR MRI can identify regions at risk for future lesion formation beyond population-level spatial patterns. We introduce FORESEE-MS, an evaluation protocol that uses a fold-specific population-prior atlas as a baseline and assesses predictions using pooled voxel-level discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC) and within-patient lesion localization (Recall@Top-K%), with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluated five deep learning models (3D U-Net, Attn+ResBlock+VAE, ViT, and two SwinUNETR variants) using 5-fold cross-validation on 39 subjects from the MSSEG-2 dataset. The atlas achieved the highest pooled voxel-level AUROC and AUPRC, with no deep learning model reliably outperforming it on either metric. However, the 3D U-Net and Attn+ResBlock+VAE achieved higher mean voxel-level within-patient Recall@Top-K% than the atlas at all evaluated thresholds, although most paired confidence intervals for the differences included zero. These findings suggest that baseline FLAIR may contain patient-specific predictive information, but in this small cohort, it remains uncertain whether this information improves lesion forecasting beyond a population-prior atlas.

papers.title_en: Systematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding for Representation Learning in Neurodegenerative Diseases
papers.authors: Nuria Balbás-Esteban, Albert Belenguer-Llorens, Elaheh Moradi, Jussi Tohka, Vanessa Gómez-Verdejo, Carlos Sevilla-Salcedo
papers.evidence: 面向神经退行性疾病的结构MRI自监督表征学习
papers.tldr: 针对神经退行性疾病早期识别中标注稀缺与扫描仪分布偏移导致监督模型泛化受限的问题，SYMBA提出面向结构脑MRI的自监督预训练框架，融合解剖约束掩码、多尺度结构相似性重建与由局部到全局的渐进课程。模型在6953例T1扫描上预训练，并在两个未见数据集上以冻结线性探针评估，AD分类AUROC达0.930，MCI转化预测0.772，低标注下仅6例即可约0.90。该工作将神经解剖先验显式纳入自监督目标，提升了分布外泛化与样本效率。
papers.abstract_en: Early identification of neurodegenerative disorders using structural T1-weighted MRI is essential for timely clinical intervention, yet supervised deep learning models often struggle to generalize due to limited annotations and scanner-induced distribution shift. Self-supervised learning offers a promising alternative; however, existing approaches are largely adapted from natural image paradigms, relying on contrastive objectives or generic masked reconstruction with voxel-wise losses, which may not fully capture the distributed morphometric patterns associated with neurodegeneration.   We introduce SYMBA (SYstematic Morphometric Brain Autoencoding), a self-supervised pretraining framework specifically designed for structural brain MRI. SYMBA integrates anatomically constrained masking, a multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM) reconstruction objective, and a progressive curriculum that transitions from local anatomical detail to global brain morphology. These components explicitly incorporate neuroanatomical structure into the self-supervised objective rather than relying on generic image priors.   Pretrained on 6,953 T1-weighted MRI scans from nine heterogeneous cohorts, SYMBA is evaluated using frozen linear probing on two independent unseen datasets, enabling a strict assessment of out-of-distribution generalization. Across multiple clinical tasks, SYMBA consistently outperforms recent neuroimaging foundation models, achieving 0.930 AUROC for Alzheimer's disease classification, 0.772 for mild cognitive impairment conversion prediction, and strong performance in amyloid status prediction. In low-label regimes, SYMBA demonstrates high sample efficiency, reaching approximately 0.90 AUROC for AD/CN classification using only six labeled subjects.

papers.title_en: Euclidean Crowding-Driven Adaptive Euclidean-Hyperbolic Graph Learning
papers.authors: Hao Chen, Jian Sun, Chuan Shi, Hongying Zhang
papers.evidence: 双曲图表示学习与自适应欧氏-双曲融合
papers.tldr: 双曲图表示在层次数据上表现优异，但其理论优势与欧氏空间局限尚不清晰。论文首先从节点嵌入的层间最小间隔量化欧氏拥挤，证明固定维欧氏嵌入树状图必然出现层间拥挤，从而削弱基于间隔的泛化界。随后给出双曲几何在层次数据上更优的泛化界解释。进而提出EH-Fusion：用指数映射将欧氏GNN表示提升到双曲空间，并按节点邻域扩展模式自适应融合两种几何。实验验证理论并显示基准数据集上的有效性。
papers.abstract_en: Hyperbolic graph representation learning has emerged as a powerful paradigm for modeling hierarchical data. Unlike Euclidean space, which exhibits polynomial volume growth, hyperbolic space grows exponentially with radius, naturally accommodating tree-like structures without the geometric distortion known as Euclidean crowding. Despite strong empirical performance, the theoretical mechanisms underlying hyperbolic embeddings remain poorly understood. In this work, we provide a geometric quantifcation research for Euclidean crowding, a generalization-theoretic explanation for the superiority of hyperbolic space on hierarchical data, and further develop an adaptive Euclidean-hyperbolic fusion learning framework toward bridging this gap. Specifically, we \textbf{first} establish a geometric quantification of Euclidean crowding by analyzing layer-wise minimum separation in node embeddings, proving that fixed-dimensional Euclidean embeddings of tree-like graphs inevitably exhibit layer-wise crowding that leads to weaker margin-based generalization bounds. \textbf{Second}, we provide a generalization-bound for the superiority of hyperbolic geometry on hierarchical data. \textbf{Third}, we propose EH-Fusion, a geometry-adaptive framework that lifts Euclidean GNN representations into hyperbolic space via exponential mapping and adaptively fuses both geometries based on node-level neighborhood expansion patterns. Extensive experiments validate our theoretical insights and demonstrate the effectiveness of EH-Fusion on benchmark datasets.
